origins.neoorigins.abyssal.name: Abssal
origins.neoorigins.abyssal.description: Makhluuqa moolka - gaashaaman, biyo ku dheereeya, oo awood u leh inuu u yeedho xulafada mas'uulka ah.Aayar oo ku engegan dhulka.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_water_breathing: Waxay u neefsadaan biyaha si dabiici ah sida hawada oo si cad ayay wax uga dhex arkaan iyaga oo aan ceeryaamo lahayn.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_underwater_mini: Miinooyinka oo xawli buuxa ku socda marka la quusiyo.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_depth_strider.d: Waxyar si degdeg ah ayay biyaha u dhex maraan.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.name: Biyaha Furan
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.desc: Si xoog leh ayuu u dabaashaa oo ka fogaa sagxada badda, ma aha oo kaliya in uu ag joogo.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.name: Dhex dhexaadnimada
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.descri: Waxay xajisaa qoto dheer marka si buuxda loo quusiyo halkii la quusin lahaa.Dabbaasha ayaa wali si caadi ah u shaqeysa.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.name: Pescivore
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.descr: Waxa kaliya oo cuni kara kalluunka.Maamulayaasha adeegaha ayaa tan ku joojin kara habaynta (ocean_origins.fish_diet_required).
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet_bonus: Codka ceeriin iyo salmon waa sida nafaqeynta sida noocyada la kariyey.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_aquatic_speed.d: Ku dhex dhaqaaqa biyaha leh istaroog xoog leh oo hufan - aad uga dheereeya kan korka deggan.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_night_vision.de: Indhuhu waxay la qabsadeen mugdi buuxa.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.abyssal_thorns_aura.des: Waxay soo celisaa 30% waxyeelada la helay weeraryahanada.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_natural_armor.d: +2 wadne (+4 max HP).Bayoloji-baddu waxay dhistaa qaab adag.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_underwater_mini: Miinadu xawaare buuxda ayay ku socotaa xataa marka la quusiyo.
Si tartiib tartiib ah ayey u bogsiisaa inta aad biyaha ku jirto - qiyaastii 1 HP 3dii sekenba.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_daylight_damage: Waxay qaadataa 1.5 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii marka ay soo gaarto iftiinka qorraxda.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.name: Wuu qallalaa
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.descr: Hawadu way soo dhacaysaa marka aad biyo ka maqan tahay: oogada aad bay u dheer tahay oo waad ku neef qabataa.Roobka, digsi-biyoodka, Neefsashada biyaha ama marin-biyoodka firfircoon ee u dhow ayaa dhammaan demiya.
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.name: Socod-mareen
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.descriptio: Taabtay Dhamaadka - wejiyada dhex mara blocks, indho fiiqid masaafo gaaban, iyo socod aan la arki karin inta badan hanjabaadaha.Sprints oo aan daalin, laakiin biyuhu waa xanuun.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_telep: Indho indhaysa meesha aad eegayso (ilaa 24 baloog).Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 tamar80-ku dhufo qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_night_vision: Waxa lagu arki karaa gudcur dhammaystiran.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
Moobyadu ma dareemaan joogitaankaaga ilaa aad weerarto mooyaane.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_water_damage: Wuxuu qaataa 1 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii marka lagu jiro biyo ama roob - madhan ayaa ka baqda biyaha.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_no_hunger_sp: Sprinting wax gaajo dheeraad ah ma bixiso.
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.name: Dhagxaan ilaaliye
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.descriptio: Waxa uu ka dhashay dhagax nool - waa maxbuus aan la gilgilan oo qodxan ku soo daadiya kuwa wax weeraraya, oo miinada ku ruxaysa gacmo qaawan, oo qoryo dhagaxa gudcurka ah ku shuba.Qunyar, laakiin dhul aan dhaqaaqin waligeed kama tagin iyaga.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_natural_armo: +3 wadne (+6 max HP).Jidhka dhagaxa ayaa ka badan hilibka.
Waxay soo celisaa 20% waxyeelada soo gaartay weeraryahanada.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_slow_movemen: 10% wuu ka gaabiyaa qofka caadiga ah.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_stone_mining: Jabiya blocks laba jeer si degdeg ah.
origins.neoorigins.verdant.name: Cagaar ah
origins.neoorigins.verdant.description: Qaab nololeed oo ka mid ah dunida cagaaran - daalin, nabad kula nool duurjoogta, laakiin gebi ahaanba la burburiyey by Nether ee musuqmaasuqa.
power.neoorigins.verdant_mobs_ignore.des: Dhammaan mooryaanta - oo ay ku jiraan kuwa cadowga ah - way ku indho-tiraan haddii aan laga xanaaqin.
Xididdada barkinta dayrta kasta.Ma qaado waxyeelo dhicid
power.neoorigins.verdant_no_hunger_sprin: Sprinting wax gaajo dheeraad ah ma bixiso.
power.neoorigins.verdant_forest_regen.de: Si tartiib ah ayuu caafimaadka u soo nooleeyaa inta uu ku jiro biomes-ka kaynta.
power.neoorigins.verdant_nether_damage.d: Waxay qaadataa 2 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii inta uu Nether ku sugan yahay.Kabaha Frost Walker waxay si buuxda uga hortagaan waxyeelada.
origins.neoorigins.umbral.name: Umbral
origins.neoorigins.umbral.description: Ilmaha hadhka leh - wuxuu ku tuuraa tamar madow, wuxuu ku dhuftaa inta u dhaxaysa boosaska, wuxuuna leexiyaa fallaadho.Ku degdega gudcurka, oo ay gubtay iftiinka qorraxda.
power.neoorigins.umbral_night_vision.des: Wuxuu si qumman u arkaa gudcur dhammaystiran.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.name: Hooska Dash
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.desc: Si xawli sare leh ugu soo boodaya jihada aad u socoto.Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 tamar60-ku dhufo qaboojin.
Waxay qaadataa 1 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii marka ay soo gaarto iftiinka qorraxda tooska ah.
power.neoorigins.umbral_projectile_immun: Fallaadhaha ayaa si aan dhib lahayn u dhex mara qaabkaaga hadhku taabtay.
power.neoorigins.umbral_no_hunger_sprint: Sprinting wax gaajo dheeraad ah ma bixiso.
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.name: Hooska Orb
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.descr: Dhig orb aan la arki karin oo muquuraya 28-block radius gudcurka.Ilaa 4 orbs firfircoon hal mar;dhigista mid cusub ayaa meesha ka saaraysa kii ugu da'da weynaa.Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 tamar60-ku dhufo qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.feline_active_launch.de: Si xoog leh ayuu kuugu jiheeyaa jihada aad eegayso.Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 tamar4-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.name: Baalasha masduulaagii
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.descrip: Si xor ah ayuu hawada ugu dul wareegayaa isagoo isticmaalaya baalal xoog badan.
power.neoorigins.draconic_active_firebal: Neefsashada 4 kubbadood oo yaryar oo dab-damis ah jihada aad eegayso.Waxay ku kacaysaa 3 adkeysi4-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.name: Barakada Dabeecada
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.desc: Dalagga kuu dhow ayaa hortaada si degdeg ah uga baxa, sidii isagoo dhulku barakeeyey.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.name: Isku xidhid
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.desc: Xididdada dhammaan makhluuqaadka u dhow oo leh gaabis VI awood leh muddo 4 ilbiriqsi ah.Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 firfircooni200-cilad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_phase.d: Wejiyada loo maro gidaarka adag ee jihada aad eegayso.3-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_bolt.de: Dabaysa bohol tamar engegan oo ku qaraxda meel ceeryaamo waxyeello leh ku jirto.Qiimaha 1 tamar4-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_starting_triden: La siiyay trident xoog badan oo sixran (Mending, Unbreaking III, Riptide III) markaad dooranayso asalkan.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_scare_ocean.des: Makhluuqa badweynta bakhtiyaa-nasiibka ah, kalluunka, dolphins-ka ayaa kaaga carara aragga.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_phase: U gudub gidaar adag jihada aad u jeeddo.Waxay ku kacaysaa 3 tamar80-ku dhufo qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_active_glows: Wuxuu dhigayaa dhagax dhalaal ah oogada sare ee aad eegayso.100-taag qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.verdant_harvest_bonus.d: Jebinta dalagyada bislaaday ama geedo yaryar waxay dhalisaa hal dhibic oo dheeri ah.
power.neoorigins.summon_minion.max_reach: Mintidiinta ugu badan ayaa mar hore loo yeeray!
power.neoorigins.summon_minion.not_enoug: Gaajo kuma filna in loo yeedho!
item.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.not_enough: Waxaad u baahan tahay heerar khibradeed %s si aad tan u isticmaasho.

origins.neoorigins.inchling.name: Inching
origins.neoorigins.inchling.description: Bani'aadam cabbirkiisu yahay rubuc kaasoo si dhib yar u cabbira derbiyada oo ku socda xawaare la yaab leh - laakiin jir jilicsan ayaa la socda dhulka.
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.name: Wax yar
Ku dheggan kara oo cabbiri kara oog kasta.
power.neoorigins.inchling_no_fall_damage: Sidaas awgeed iftiinka soo dhacayaa waligiis ma damco.
power.neoorigins.inchling_reduced_health: -5 wadnaha (-10 max HP).Jirka afar-geesoodka ah wuxuu hayaa rubuc ciqaabta.
power.neoorigins.inchling_speed_boost.de: Dhaqso 15% ka badan sidii caadiga ahayd.
power.neoorigins.inchling_hunger_efficie: Gaajada badhkeed ayuu u degdegaa sida ciyaartoyga caadiga ah.
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.name: Kaftan
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.description: Nooc fangas ah oo ku dhex baara mugdiga iyo beeraha likaha - oo ku hubaysan xadhkaha sunta ah, laakiin ay engegaan iftiinka qorraxda.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_spore_cloud.d: Dabayaa xabagta xabagta ka soo baxda oo ku qaraxda daruur raagay oo ah xadhkaha sunta ah.Waxay ku kacaysaa 3 nafisnimo.12-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.
Waxa uu si cad wax uga arki karaa gudcurka guud.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
